segments.name: Retail operations segment
segments.description: Operates department stores and dillards.com selling fashion apparel, cosmetics, accessories and home furnishings to consumers.
segments.evidence: we operated 271 Dillard's stores, including 28 clearance centers, and an Internet store at dillards.com offering a wide selection of merchandise including fashion apparel for women, men and children, accessories, cosmetics, home furnishings and other consumer goods.

segments.name: Construction segment
segments.description: General contracting construction company that constructs and remodels stores, including for the Company.
segments.evidence: The Company also operates a general contracting construction company, CDI Contractors, LLC ("CDI"), a portion of whose business includes constructing and remodeling stores for the Company, which is a reportable segment separate from our retail operations.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for merchandise bought in retail stores and online; the Company also receives compensation from Citi based on the private label card portfolio's earnings.
revenueModel.evidence: Pursuant to the Citibank Alliance, we receive on-going cash compensation from Citi based upon the portfolio's earnings.
